description: Production-oriented ASP.NET Core application template with structured logging, security headers, forwarded headers, rate limiting, centralized error handling, cookie authentication, authenticated-by-default routed endpoints, policy-based authorization, and EF Core-ready structure.
releaseNotes: Minor 2.6.0 release of the NetCoreApplicationTemplate dotnet new template. This release migrates repository and distribution metadata to the AsiBackbone organization, establishes ghcr.io/asibackbone/netcoreapplicationtemplate as the canonical repository-maintained container image, updates GitHub Packages and consumer-facing repository references, and refreshes GitHub Actions security tooling while preserving the stable NetCoreApplicationTemplate package ID, template identities, supported template options, and runtime application behavior.
title: .NET Core Application Template
